title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 22 MARCH 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 22 March 2026. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces and in Nuwara-Eliya district after 1.00 pm. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other parts of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kaluthara and Kurunegala districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
